description: Probe a GET endpoint several times and report status codes and latency statistics (min/avg/max). The cheap way for an agent to verify an API — for example one found on the x402 Bazaar — responds before spending real money calling it. Use this when an agent needs to status and latency stats — test an API before relying on it. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_api_health_check
title: API Health Check
